title: Every unit of blood a hospital uses began with someone in a donor chair
alt: A part-filled blood bag lying in a tray on a mixing scale, its tube running up out of the frame, over a patterned carpet.

posts.facebook:
Every unit of blood a hospital uses began with someone sitting in a donor chair. Curious what it takes?

First, check whether you can give. NHS Blood and Transplant in England and the American Red Cross publish their rules online. Then book an appointment at a donor center, or at a blood drive (a pop-up collection session) near you.

On the day, you'll answer a health and lifestyle check, so the team can decide whether donating is right for you. Just answer honestly.

Have you given blood before?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/give-blood/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do

Photo: U.S. Air Force photo by Tech. Sgt. Nicholas Alder, Public domain (public domain), via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ramstein_blood_donation_expands;_saves_lives_(7395804).jpg (cropped).
